This pathway implies that Spermine may influence the activity of sodium channel protein type 11 subunit alpha, which in turn affects the function of L-lactate dehydrogenase C chain. The final score of 0.5937 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, supported by the sequential targeting of these entities. The mechanism involves a chain of interactions, where Spermine acts as a modulator of the sodium channel, which then influences the enzyme activity of L-lactate dehydrogenase C chain. However, the strength of this relationship remains uncertain, and further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct involvement of Spermine in the regulation of L-lactate dehydrogenase C chain.
